thread:
Marco (VP Product): Quick follow-up from the all-hands segment on customer wins/losses — can we get a short, actionable list of top reasons we won and lost deals last quarter plus one concrete fix for each that we can target in 30/60/90d? Trying to produce something leadership can act on.

Leah (Customer Success): From CS — wins: fast onboarding, clear Dedicated offering, responsive success team. Losses: pricing surprises in pilots, no ready private-deploy checklist, slow pilot turnarounds. Concrete fixes: 30d: publish private-deploy quickstart checklist + templates; 60d: pricing explainer + example contract language; 90d: pilot acceleration playbook + SLA options.

Aisha (PM): Echo on observability asks — token-level cost breakdown per-route keeps coming up. Short plan: 30d mock UI + feedback session; 60d small API to expose route-level cost; 90d GA dashboard.

Ethan (Sales): Sales perspective: we lose a lot of enterprise RFPs due to missing air-gapped option and unclear support SLAs. Wins usually cite predictable latency and clear escape/fallback policies. Suggest immediate: 30d one-pager for AE rebuttals + reference architecture; 60d publish fallback policy templates.

Priya (Eng): Engineering notes: a few losses were driven by perf regressions on quantized models for long sequences. Short-term: add rollout guardrails and a perf smoke test for long-seq workloads (60d). Medium: automated perf gates in CI (90d).

Sam (CEO): +1. Leadership will prioritize pilot turnaround time and that private-deploy quickstart. Expect exec-owned owners assigned this week.

Marco (VP Product): I'll own the 30d checklist. Leah / Aisha / Ethan — please sync so I can convert into tickets.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4321: "Private deployment quickstart checklist" assigned to Marco, due in 30 days.

Leah (Customer Success): Can we add the top 3 customers who requested this recently? @Ethan can you DM me the list so we can attach examples to the checklist.

Aisha (PM): Also want a one-pager for AEs on our fallback policy + when to upsell Dedicated. Simple, <1 page.

Ethan (Sales): ACK — will draft and share by EOD Friday.

Priya (Eng): tagging eng-runtime / eng-oncall for the perf smoke tests: @eng-runtime FYI — will start a spike this week.

Marco (VP Product): Thanks everyone — I'll post owners + timelines in here by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
